---
title: "Noticias"
page-layout: full
toc: false
listing:
  id: listing-noticias
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 4
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: false
  fields: [image, date, title, description]
  page-size: 12
  filter-ui: false
format:
  html:
    body-classes: noticias-index-page
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script>
          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            var container = document.getElementById("listing-listing-noticias");
            var grid = container && container.querySelector(".list.grid");
            var nav = document.getElementById("listing-noticias-pagination");
            var nomatch = container && container.querySelector(".listing-no-matching");
            if (container && grid && nav && nav.parentElement === grid) {
              container.appendChild(nav);
            }
            if (container && grid && nomatch && nomatch.parentElement === grid) {
              container.appendChild(nomatch);
            }
            if (grid) {
              window.__NOTICIAS_ITEMS = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll(".g-col-1"));
            }
          }, true);
          </script>
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="noticias-click.js" defer></script>
          <script src="noticias-listing-fix.js" defer></script>
---
